threads.body: I don't get this. Why should we preserve the current span here? Isn't it just supposed to propagate the context that was current on subscribe whatever that may have been. As far as I understand the `Span.fromContext(traceContext).getSpanContext().isValid()` check was an optimization to avoid doing unnecessary work when context is empty, changing it to `traceContext != io.opentelemetry.context.Context.root()` should be enough.

[General] The surrounding `if` guarantees `hasContextToPropagate` is false, so this ternary's `traceContext` branch is unreachable. Keep the retry-clearing path unconditional so its behavior is explicit.
